lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal rows of high-luminance circular clusters of varying diameters, with higher density and smaller radii in the anterior region posterior to the gills, transitioning to larger, more isolated nodes toward the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of increased pixel intensity intersect with horizontal spot rows, creating a coarse grid-like pattern across the mid-lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two distinct longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance shift from high intensity on the dorsal edge to localized shadowing on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Moderate distribution of high-luminance blobs concentrated primarily on the lower half and posterior margin of the first dorsal fin's lateral surface.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a smaller carcharhiniform-shaped secondary subject swimming in close proximity ventral to the primary subject's mid-section.
